description: This file defines an abstract class PDFEngine within the SuiteCRM\PDF namespace, outlining methods for PDF generation and manipulation, including writing HTML, headers, footers, adding CSS, and outputting PDFs.

classes.name: PDFEngine
classes.description: An abstract class that specifies the interface for PDF engine implementations, including methods for writing HTML content, headers, footers, CSS, and outputting PDFs.

methods.name: writeHTML
methods.description: Abstract method to write HTML content into the PDF.

methods.name: writeFooter
methods.description: Abstract method to write footer content into the PDF.

methods.name: writeHeader
methods.description: Abstract method to write header content into the PDF.

methods.name: addCSS
methods.description: Abstract method to add CSS styles to the PDF.

methods.name: writeBlankPage
methods.description: Abstract method to insert a blank page into the PDF.

methods.name: outputPDF
methods.description: Abstract method to output the generated PDF with specified name and destination.

methods.name: configurePDF
methods.description: Abstract method to configure PDF options.
